rules.length: Only saved finish_reason=length; token count alone is insufficient.
rules.explicit_timeout: Only saved timed_out=true or explicit timeout status.
rules.missing_required_entrypoint: Expected callable absent after pinned sanitizer; AST only.
rules.syntax_or_extraction: Empty selected code or AST SyntaxError; no generated-code execution.
rules.assertion_stderr_hint: SciCode failed, returncode nonzero, timed_out=false, AssertionError hint. Medium confidence; not raw traceback proof.
rules.unknown: Binary rejection, generic fail, or non-assertion exception hint cannot identify assertion vs runtime vs per-test timeout.
not_inferred: No hidden-test inputs or reference answers read.
No claimed timeout from long generation or algorithm complexity.
EvalPlus fail may include internal timeout; only separate timeout is unambiguous.
